items.title: Harvey Jones Interview
items.q: Now that was your first group in about 1922, and Homer Brown Blues on Paramount and Tiger Rag on the reverse. This is the one with Ernest Tapley, Banjo, James Turner, guitar, Saul Turner.

ctx.x: No, the band left me here. Oh. The band left me, went on back to Louisville. I stayed here and made records with the Power Mount Company, and I had a band of my own, a little four piece and five piece, combo band. I played all around in the various night club, Kelly's Stable, Sherman House.

You played Sherman? Yeah, I played Sherman House. Yeah. All right. Then with that, with that group you made the Paramount record. Now that was your first group in about 1922, and Homer Brown Blues on Paramount and Tiger Rag on the reverse. This is the one with Ernest Tapley, Banjo, James Turner, guitar, Saul Turner. Was he a brother?
No, he was just a friend of ours.
